result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: duplicate Green Bowl Poké cards in Fastest near you, inconsistent favorite heart button styling in Popular right now, and clipped restaurant name at carousel edge.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards side-by-side with same image, '15-25 min' badge and '€0.90 delivery' text
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the feed data and ensure each carousel card represents a unique restaurant

issues.description: Favorite heart button styling is inconsistent in 'Popular right now': the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a bare white outline heart with no background, while the pizza card below shows a heart inside a dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent circular scrim/background to all favorite icons for visibility and tap target consistency

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows restaurant name clipped mid-word as 'Smash Bros Bu' at the screen edge
issues.suggestion: Add proper carousel end padding and use ellipsis truncation for restaurant titles so text does not clip mid-character
